recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies FHIR-50649 after the related Transport cleanup decisions; adding TransportInputParameterType or TransportOutputParameterType now would reintroduce bindings for elements that no longer exist. Any future expansion of TransportReason code content should be handled as a new terminology/content decision, not as unfinished FHIR-50649 application.
issue_request: FHIR-50649 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 OO change request asking for missing example ValueSets for Transport.input.type, Transport.output.type, and Transport.reason (TransportInputParameterType, TransportOutputParameterType, and TransportReason).
initial_application: The original Jira resolution asked editors to use IHE SET/profile material for examples. The actual application path was split by related Transport decisions: FHIR-50911 removed Transport.input and Transport.output, and comments on FHIR-50649 state that those removals eliminated two of the three requested ValueSets. The remaining TransportReason work was carried forward through FHIR-40310 and applied in commit a8f7c81ebc, which added source/transport/valueset-transport-reason.xml and bound Transport.reason to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/transport-reason.
additional_context: FHIR-50911 is already represented on the combined branch and remains relevant because its Applied/Persuasive-with-Modification decision removed the request-oriented Transport input/output elements from the current resource. FHIR-40310 records the final TransportReason disposition: no rename was needed because Transport.reasonCode was gone, and an example ValueSet should be created. OO Confluence minutes from 2025-07-28 and 2025-07-29 match this path by documenting proposed TransportReason/input/output concepts and the subsequent Transport input/output removal discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was made because the current source contains Transport.reason with an example binding to ValueSet/transport-reason, source/transport/valueset-transport-reason.xml defines TransportReason with the selected v2-0003 codes, and source/transport/structuredefinition-Transport.xml no longer contains Transport.input, Transport.output, or Transport.reasonCode elements that would need the other requested ValueSets.
